_doc: THE LANE'S LAYOUT — a working drawing, section by section (decibel PLAN 2.6; RUNNING_LOG §324; DEC-103: 'lets do mics at top for now let me see it; layout s1 up to 3body pls'). Each section is drawn on the notation's OWN frame (the app's and the film's page: names, brackets, the staff's opening snippet, the grey lines) with its notes left out, and the signs decided for it added from the piece's save. tools/signs/build_layout.js -> score/public/signs/layout.html (http://localhost:5500/signs/layout.html). The numbers here are PROVISIONAL places for him to judge by eye; a settled place becomes a row of notation/registry/rules.json by a device sheet — not this file.

lane._doc: the standard gap between a dividing line and the nearest object, top and bottom. The rule is his (DEC-98); the SIZE is the AI's first number — one staff space, the frame's own edge pad — his to move.

mic._doc: the mic opening: at the lane's TOP 'for now' (his word, DEC-103), under the gap; a fifth of the lane tall, as the composer score draws it. Its colour and recipe: bank/signs/mic_opening.json `chosen`. No name on it — no words in the lanes (DEC-99).

badge._doc: the announcing badge: once a section, in the mic's row. `at` firstMic = just left of each lane's first mic opening (the AI's suggestion, RUNNING_LOG §323) · sectionStart = all five in a column where the section begins. `alt` is drawn once more, on the first page only, for comparison.

sections.name: 1 · The opening — 0 … 37 s
sections.shows: Each short attack is a mic opening, alone: no conductor's arc, no note, no badge on the openings (DEC-102). The short attacks' badge stands once in each lane.
